description: Embedded observation shapes for the polaris.escalation wire format. Each def represents one variant of the internal polaris-types::ObservationKind enum, filtered to variants that are safe to federate (i.e. carry no internal moderator identifiers or operator-internal signals). Embedded inside escalation records; none of these defs are standalone ATProto records.

imageHashCluster.description: A perceptual-hash (SimHash) match: the subject's content hashes within `distance` Hamming steps of a known-harmful reference hash. Corresponds to ObservationKind::ImageHashCluster in polaris-types.

hash.description: Hex-encoded perceptual hash of the subject's content. The hash algorithm (e.g. pHash, dHash, SimHash) is implied by the detector version; consumers should treat this as an opaque comparable string unless they know the producing detector's algorithm.

distance.description: Hamming distance between `hash` and the reference cluster centroid hash. A value of 0 means an exact match; higher values indicate closer-but-not-identical perceptual similarity. The threshold used by the pattern engine is operator-configured and not transmitted.

accountCohort.description: An account-cohort match: the subject account was created in the same narrow time window as other suspicious accounts sharing behavioral fingerprints. Corresponds to ObservationKind::AccountCohort in polaris-types.

cohortId.description: Opaque cohort identifier assigned by the pattern engine. Two observations with the same cohortId belong to the same detected wave. The identifier is not globally unique across instances — it is local to the originating labeler.

similarityScore.description: Similarity score of this account within the cohort, encoded as scaled-integer in [0, 1000] (divide by 1000.0 to recover the float in [0.0, 1.0]). ATProto Lexicons have no native float type; scaled-integer is the standard encoding. 1000 means the account is a perfect match to the cohort centroid; values closer to 0 indicate peripheral members.

replyBrigade.description: A reply-brigade detection: the subject's replies to a specific thread were part of a coordinated burst of inauthentic engagement. Corresponds to ObservationKind::ReplyBrigade in polaris-types.

threadUri.description: AT-URI of the thread that was targeted by the reply brigade. This is the conversation root, not a specific reply. Receivers can use this to correlate brigade detections across instances targeting the same thread.

externalLabel.description: An ATProto label from a third-party upstream labeler that Polaris has ingested and weighted. Corresponds to ObservationKind::ExternalLabel in polaris-types. Useful when escalating: the receiving instance can independently verify the upstream label.

source.description: DID of the upstream labeler that emitted the label. The receiving instance can subscribe to this labeler independently to cross-check the claim.

labelValue.description: Label value as emitted by the upstream labeler (e.g. '!hide', 'spam', 'csam'). The receiver should interpret this in the context of the upstream labeler's policy, not Polaris's own label vocabulary.

weight.description: Operator-configured trust weight for this upstream labeler at the time the observation was recorded, encoded as scaled-integer in [0, 1000] (divide by 1000.0 to recover the float in [0.0, 1.0]). ATProto Lexicons have no native float type; scaled-integer is the standard encoding. This reflects the *originating* labeler's calibration and is informational for the receiver — the receiver applies its own weight.

classifierSignal.description: An ML classifier signal: a machine-learning model scored the subject's content and emitted a label with a confidence score. Corresponds to ObservationKind::ClassifierSignal in polaris-types.

model.description: Identifier of the classifier model that produced this signal (e.g. 'csam-detector-v3', 'spam-bert-v2'). Opaque to receivers — intended for audit trails and reproducibility. The receiving instance cannot re-run the same model unless it deploys it independently.

label.description: Classifier-emitted label string. Vocabulary is model-specific and not constrained by this Lexicon. Receivers should treat this as an opaque tag unless they have out-of-band knowledge of the model's label vocabulary.

confidence.description: Classifier's confidence in the label, encoded as scaled-integer in [0, 1000] (divide by 1000.0 to recover the float in [0.0, 1.0]). ATProto Lexicons have no native float type; scaled-integer is the standard encoding. 1000 means maximum confidence. This is the model's raw output confidence, not Polaris's cross-detector calibrated confidence (which is on the parent escalation's observation entry).

observationKind.description: Discriminator tag for the embedded observation union inside escalation records. Values correspond to the ObservationKind enum variants in polaris-types that are safe to federate. Variants carrying internal moderator identifiers (moderatorBehaviorAnomaly) or operator-internal signals (reportVolumeAnomaly) are excluded from the wire format per the privacy boundary policy.
